oil.when: 2007 (Oil Life System reset with the instrument cluster reset stem)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
With the engine off, turn the key to On.
Press and release the reset stem on the instrument cluster until OIL LIFE shows.
When OIL LIFE and RESET take turns on the display, press and hold the reset stem until you hear several beeps.
Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the Tire and Loading Information label on the driver's door (cold means parked at least three hours or driven under a mile).
There is no reset button. The low tire pressure light stays on until the pressure is corrected, then goes off on its own.
Clearing the CHECK TIRE PRESSURE message with the display controls only hides it for now. It returns at the next start if a tire is still low.
tpms.note: If the light comes on only on cold mornings and goes off as you drive, a tire is getting low: check and top up the pressures.
